periods.label: 速度中毒
titles: 破军学园二年二班C级骑士

appearance.overview: Athletic, lively girl with tanned skin, sportswear and knuckle-type Device.

personality.summary: Energetic, friendly and confident in speed; underestimates Ikki because she misreads his prior struggle with Kirihara.

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Opponent who catches her supersonic attack and wins instantly.
relationships.hagum-student-council: One of the ranked student council fighters.

periods.summary: Renren faces Ikki as Hagun's third-ranked student and explains Mach Greed, which lets her ignore deceleration and build speed past Mach levels. She assumes Ikki cannot handle unseen speed because of his fight with Kirihara, but Ikki catches her once she enters his sword range and slams her to the floor, ending her undefeated streak.

key_events.summary: Loses to Ikki after her supersonic Black Bird attack is read and countered.
